Do not invent expected status/fields that are absent from expected_source. observations and outputs must use the exact call_id from the tool message's output_reference (or the assessment manifest). An output_reference of null means this call has no settled persisted evidence; do not cite its diagnostic output as observations or outputs. If an expectation could not be tested, report the step blocked/skipped/error with its concrete reason and checks=[] rather than inventing an observation for a not_run check. A tool message is a model-facing projection: download links, projection fields and digest truncation markers are not necessarily persisted output values. Evidence availability alone does not prove any expectation. observations and outputs reference actual call_id and literal output_path_tokens into persisted tool output, never input examples or invented actual values. output_path_tokens is relative to the manifest entry's output value: do not prefix it with output or the call ID. For example an output {"body": {"literal.key": false}} is referenced by ["body", "literal.key"]. A present null can be checked; a missing field cannot. [] means the entire value. outputs maps field names to references; output_source optionally copies a complete object instead. For nested objects or arrays composed from multiple calls, use output_structure: a reference node has kind=reference and source={call_id,output_path_tokens}; an object node has kind=object and fields mapping literal keys to nodes; an array node has kind=array and items listing nodes in order. Every leaf must reference an actual persisted tool value, never contain a literal actual value. The server resolves the leaves; declare structure that matches the fixed plan's consumer paths. Choose only one of outputs, output_source or output_structure. Use deterministic operators when the fixed expected value is directly comparable. For natural-language business expectations, use semantic with verdict and a reason grounded in all necessary observations; identify incomplete evidence as not_run. These semantic decisions remain AI judgments. State blocked/skipped/error and the concrete reason for unfinished steps; successful preparation does not prove the target.
